grammar.summary: 本课学习 some/any 的基本用法与不可数名词。

points.title: some 与 any
points.explanation: some 用于肯定句（There is some cheese.）；any 用于否定和疑问（Is there any bread? There isn't any milk.）。两者既可修饰不可数也可修饰复数可数名词。

examples.en: There's some cheese in the fridge.

points.title: 不可数名词
points.explanation: bread、cheese、milk、soap、sugar 等物质名词不可数，不能加 a/s，谓语用单数，计量用 a loaf of / a bar of。

examples.en: Is there a bottle of milk?
